description: Dataset for 'An investigation into wind loading on railway overhead line electrification structures' is a data set deposited in University of Southampton Repository by its authors Oliver Anthony John. This is a dataset of the raw data analysed within the thesis: An investigation into wind loading on railway overhead line electrification structures. https://doi.org/10.5258/SOTON/PG/T215. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
